system.description:
Your understanding of the processes the corpse undergoes allows you to freeze the muscles of another being in the same deathly paralysis. You must be able to see your target. Expend a Willpower Trait and engage your target in a Mental Challenge. Success paralyzes your target for three turns as if he had been staked through the heart.

After three turns, the target can perform a Simple Test at the beginning of each turn; success frees him of the paralysis. He may also expend a Willpower Trait and make a Simple Test to move on a turn through sheer force of will, though he is still held and will be immobile again the next turn. If he loses, he takes a single level of bashing damage from the strain and still cannot move.
